t: 安哥拉首都罗安达由葡萄牙航海家保罗·迪亚斯·德·诺瓦伊斯所建立.
te: Luanda, the capital of Angola, is founded by the Portuguese navigator Paulo Dias de Novais.
dz: 安哥拉首都罗安达由葡萄牙航海家保罗·迪亚斯·德·诺瓦伊斯所建立.
de: Luanda, the capital of Angola, is founded by the Portuguese navigator Paulo Dias de Novais.

t: 莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴尔在图卡罗伊战役中击败了孟加拉达乌德·汗·卡拉尼的苏丹.
te: Mughal Emperor Akbar defeats Sultan of Bengal Daud Khan Karrani's army at the Battle of Tukaroi.
dz: 莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴尔在图卡罗伊战役中击败了孟加拉达乌德·汗·卡拉尼的苏丹.
de: Mughal Emperor Akbar defeats Sultan of Bengal Daud Khan Karrani's army at the Battle of Tukaroi.

t: 织田信长与德川家康联军长筱之战取得胜利。
te: The combined forces of Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu are victorious in the Battle of Nagashino.
dz: 日本战国时代：织田信长与德川家康联军长筱之战取得胜利。
de: Sengoku period of Japan: The combined forces of Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu are victorious in the Battle of Nagashino.

t: 雷德斯韦尔号的突袭是英格兰和苏格兰之间最后一次大战.
te: The Raid of the Redeswire is the last major battle between England and Scotland.
dz: 雷德斯韦尔号的突袭是英格兰和苏格兰之间最后一次大战.
de: The Raid of the Redeswire is the last major battle between England and Scotland.

t: 吉斯公爵亨利一世手下的罗马天主教势力击败了新教徒,俘虏了菲利普·德·莫尔奈等.
te: Roman Catholic forces under Henry I, Duke of Guise, defeat the Protestants, capturing Philippe de Mornay among others.
dz: 吉斯公爵亨利一世手下的罗马天主教势力击败了新教徒,俘虏了菲利普·德·莫尔奈等.
de: Roman Catholic forces under Henry I, Duke of Guise, defeat the Protestants, capturing Philippe de Mornay among others.

t: 智利瓦尔迪维亚发生地震,震级估计为8.5Mw.
te: An earthquake with an estimated magnitude of 8.5Mw strikes Valdivia, Chile.
dz: 智利瓦尔迪维亚发生地震,震级估计为8.5Mw.
